title: RNA-Seq Analysis of Long Non-Coding RNAs and Protein-Coding Gene Pairs
author: Julia Yue Cui
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.n2tdgen
materials: Pathway analysis of differentially regulated PCGs and lncRNAs: The differentially regulated PCGs by 1) BDE-47 in CV mice, 2) BDE-99 in CV mice, 3) BDE-47 in GF mice or 4) BDE-99 in GF mice were each analyzed using Ingenuity Pathway Analysis (IPA, QIAGEN, Valencia, CA) to determine significantly altered gene networks. The PCGs that were uniquely regulated by each of the above four cases were further analyzed by IPA to determine the specific effect of BDE-47 and BDE-99 in CV and GF conditions. LncRNAs that were differentially regulated in each of the above four cases were separated into four datasets, and their paired PCGs in each dataset were submitted for STRING (Search Tool for the Retrieval of Interacting Genes/Proteins) analysis (https://string-db.org/).

steps.title: Prepare RNA-Seq Libraries
steps.instruction: Prepare libraries from liver samples of adult male conventional (CV) and germ free (GF) mice treated with vehicle (corn oil), BDE-47, or BDE-99 using the poly A-tail selection method and TruSeq version 3 chemistry.

steps.title: Sequence and Map Reads
steps.instruction: Sequence the libraries using a HiSeq 2000 sequencer and map quality-filtered reads to the mouse reference genome (mm10) using HISAT v 0.1.6 beta.

substeps.instruction: Convert SAM files to BAM files using Samtools (version 1.2)

steps.title: Determine Transcript Abundance and Expression
steps.instruction: Determine transcript abundance and differential expression using Cufflinks (CuffDiff) v 2.2.1, utilizing UCSC mm10.gtf for protein-coding genes (PCGs) and NONCODE2016 lncRNA reference gtf files.

substeps.instruction: Express transcript abundance as fragments per kilobase of transcript per million mapped reads (FPKM)
Define PCGs as significantly expressed in liver if average FPKM value is above 1 in at least one group
Perform differential expression analysis using Cuffdiff (p < 0.05) between chemical-exposed groups and vehicle-exposed groups of the same enterotypes

steps.title: Generate Venn Diagrams
steps.instruction: Generate Venn diagrams of differentially expressed PCGs and lncRNAs based on standardized mean FPKM values using JMP Genome Software (SAS Institute, Cary, NC).

steps.title: Annotate and Visualize lncRNA Locations
steps.instruction: Use the web-based tool PAVIS (https://manticore.niehs.nih.gov/pavis2/) to annotate and visualize the genomic location of lncRNAs relative to the closest PCGs.

substeps.instruction: Include regions up to 5 kb upstream of transcription start site (TSS)
Include intronic, exonic, 5’-untranslated region (UTR), and 3’-UTR regions
Include regions up to 1 kb downstream of transcriptional termination site (TTS)

steps.title: Identify lncRNA-PCG Pairs
steps.instruction: Identify lncRNA-PCG pairs based on specific genomic and expression criteria.

substeps.instruction: Ensure the lncRNA overlaps with or is within 5 kb upstream of TSS or 1 kb downstream of TTS of its closest PCG
Verify both the PCG and neighboring lncRNA are differentially regulated by PBDE exposure compared to vehicle-treated group of the same enterotypes (p < 0.05)

steps.title: Visualize Gene Structure
steps.instruction: Visualize the gene structure and relative genomic location of the identified lncRNA-PCG pairs using Integrated Genome Viewer (Broad Institute, Cambridge, MA).
